title: Protective effects of Ganoderma lucidum spores on estradiol benzoate-induced TEC apoptosis and compromised double-positive thymocyte development

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: An empirical mouse study tests GLS intervention on thymic atrophy explicitly identified as the onset of immune aging and reports use of multi-omics techniques.
